payload.title: UI Controller v5: single shared coordinator gate

contract_compliance.shared_gate: Coordinator owns ONE RLock (gate G). All controllers delegate to it. No per-controller mutexes. Lease acquire/release/reclaim all use G.
contract_compliance.repro_1: Admission/reservation race: 10 threads, one gate, max_actions=1. Exactly 1 intent journaled. Tested.
contract_compliance.repro_2: Transfer during acting: stale token fenced via LeaseError. Valid token passes. Tested.
contract_compliance.first_profile: Single process, one coordinator owns G + lease + journal. Cross-process dispatch explicitly prohibited (not silently unsupported).
contract_compliance.cleanup: Response close in finally block covering read exceptions and overflow.

payload.tests: 14/14 pass. Both repros from your contract covered.
payload.not_yet: No live input. Awaiting your v5 review.
